package main

import (
 "context"
 "encoding/json"
 "os"
 "path/filepath"
 "runtime"
 "runtime/pprof"
 "testing"
 "fmt"
 "time"
 jt "github.com/mellowforge/jsontrans-go"
 js "github.com/mellowforge/jsontrans-go/javascript"
)

func TestMemoryDiagnostic(t *testing.T) {
 dir := os.Getenv("JSONTRANS_MEMORY_DIAGNOSTICS")
 if dir == "" { t.Fatal("JSONTRANS_MEMORY_DIAGNOSTICS is required") }
 f,err := os.Create(filepath.Join(dir,"samples.jsonl")); if err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}; defer f.Close()
 enc:=json.NewEncoder(f)
 ctx,cancel:=context.WithTimeout(context.Background(),5*time.Minute);defer cancel()
 r:=report{GuestCapBytes:64<<20,Outcomes:make(map[string]outcome)}
 for cycle:=1;cycle<=80;cycle++ {
  e,err:=js.New(ctx,js.Config{GuestMemoryBytes:64<<20,Limits:jt.Limits{Timeout:10*time.Second}}); if err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
  if err:=exercise(ctx,e,settings{Iterations:25,Workers:2},&r);err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
  if err:=e.Close();err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
  e=nil
  pre:=runtime.NumGoroutine()
  yield:=os.Getenv("JSONTRANS_MEMORY_YIELD")=="1"
  if yield { runtime.Gosched() }
  afterYield:=runtime.NumGoroutine()
  var first uint64
  for gc:=1;gc<=3;gc++ {
   runtime.GC()
   var m runtime.MemStats;runtime.ReadMemStats(&m)
   if gc==1 {first=m.HeapAlloc}
   if err:=enc.Encode(map[string]any{"cycle":cycle,"gc":gc,"pre_gc_goroutines":pre,"after_yield_goroutines":afterYield,"yield":yield,"heap_alloc":m.HeapAlloc,"heap_objects":m.HeapObjects,"num_gc":m.NumGC,"goroutines":runtime.NumGoroutine()});err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
   if gc==1 && first>1<<20 && os.Getenv("JSONTRANS_MEMORY_PROFILE")=="1" {
    p,err:=os.Create(filepath.Join(dir,fmt.Sprintf("spike-%03d.pprof",cycle)));if err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
    if err:=pprof.WriteHeapProfile(p);err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)};if err:=p.Close();err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
   }
  }
 }
 if err:=enc.Encode(map[string]any{"recoveries":r.Recoveries,"cycles":80,"source":"8e7e84c","profile_rate":runtime.MemProfileRate});err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
}
